title: Solayer USD (sUSD) — no external unprivileged extraction from the usdc-pool-program mint/redeem/NAV surface; pool is in sunset (deposits closed)
closed_reasons: Deposit (the only free-mint path) is CLOSED: deposit.rs:73 -> 6039 DepositClosed. The pool is in a sunset wind-down (batchDepositStatus=2).

All 14 manager/operator/rateAuthority instructions revert 2001 ConstraintHasOne when signed by a neutral third party: set_manager, set_operator, set_rate_authority, set_fee, update_susd_metadata, update_susd_rate, create_susd_offset_pda, emergency_transfer_rwa_token, initiate_batch_deposit, resolve_batch_deposit, initiate_batch_withdraw, resolve_batch_withdraw, collect_fee, sunset_finalize.

Correct-signer controls prove the gate is signer identity: set_fee signed by the real manager SUCCEEDS; update_susd_rate signed by the real rateAuthority and initiate_batch_withdraw signed by the real operator pass has_one and then revert 6036 PoolSunset; resolve_batch_withdraw signed by the real operator reverts 6026 InvalidStatus.

withdraw (the only unprivileged value-moving instruction) escrows the caller's OWN sUSD into poolSusdVault and moves NO USDC. Live replay for holder DgCkhZVt...: -1000 raw sUSD from their ATA into poolSusdVault, +0 USDC. USDC payout is a separate operator-gated resolve_batch_withdraw.

withdraw with a victim's sUSD vault -> 2015 ConstraintTokenOwner; withdraw re-using another user's WithdrawProof -> 2006 ConstraintSeeds; deposit with a victim's USDC account -> 2015 ConstraintTokenOwner.

claim_with_migrated_deposit_proof with the attacker's own vault -> 2015 ConstraintTokenOwner; with the proof's vault but attacker signer -> 2003 ConstraintRaw. migrate_deposit_proof -> 2006 ConstraintSeeds.
handle_frozen_accounts -> 6026 InvalidStatus (handle_frozen_account.rs:215); it needs an active batch status the attacker cannot create.

sunset_initiate_batch_withdraw account layout could not be reconstructed (it is absent from the stale on-chain IDL) and it was not exercised on-chain in the sampled window; it is the operator-gated sunset twin of initiate_batch_withdraw whose RWA vaults are already empty, so it is not an E-U vector.
initialize fails (system CPI, pool already exists); sunset_redeem_all fails (system CPI, RWA already redeemed).

Escrows 'amount' raw sUSD from the signer's ATA into poolSusdVault. Verified: userUsdcVault of proof pzWrVqaj... equals ATA(proof.from, USDC).

Stored ratio withdrawUsdcSusdTokenRatio = 1482371326/1291803292 = 1.14752.

sUSD is a Token-2022 interest-bearing mint: preUpdateAverageRate 806, uiAmount multiplier ~1.1814 (uiAmount/raw = 729545.645829/617526.573503). Redeem is at the raw ratio (~1.1467 USDC/raw) so accrued ui-interest slightly exceeds USDC backing (a holder shortfall, not an attacker gain).
All 27 CI simulations matched their expected outcome (14 has_one gates, 3 correct-signer controls, deposit closed, 4 user-path gates, 1 live escrow replay). No unprivileged path moved USDC.
Role keys are plain system accounts: manager 7671j7qp... (0.0999 SOL, Squads vault), operator AxnDY6n... (0.2846 SOL, hot key), rateAuthority uRwMu21... (0.2883 SOL).
caveats: Single snapshot at slot 461,393,409 (CI re-read at ~461,396,307); balances and USD prices drift. USDC $0.9995984819 (DefiLlama ts 1792960181).

The on-chain IDL is stale: it omits the three sunset_* instructions and the SunsetInfo account type, and its Status enum (2 variants) disagrees with the deployed code (batchDepositStatus observed = 2). sunset_initiate_batch_withdraw's account list is therefore inferred, not verified.
sunset_redeem_all cannot be re-run to observe success (its RWA vault is already empty); it reverts with a system CPI error for both attacker and manager.

handle_frozen_accounts was only testable in the current (Inactive) batch state, where it reverts 6026 InvalidStatus; its behaviour under an active batch could not be exercised because only the operator can create that state.
E-U is $0 at this snapshot; a program upgrade (upgrade authority is live) or a re-opened deposit path would require a fresh pass. Re-run ci/run.sh after any change to last_deploy_slot.
one_liner: Solayer USD (sUSD) is not exploitable by an external unprivileged attacker right now: the mint path is closed (sunset) and the only unprivileged value-mover, withdraw, merely escrows the caller's own sUSD while every USDC-moving instruction is has_one-gated to the operator/manager; E-U $0 (high confidence), with ~$707,819 of pool USDC redeemable by sUSD holders and controllable by the manager (Squads) / operator hot key.
